bearing.config.v1alpha1.CapabilityGrant..description:
CapabilityGrant is one capability an adapter may call, with its scope
 (ADR 9), for example http limited to hosts.

name.description:
The capability: http, log, trace, metrics, config, kv or clock. The list
 is ADR 9's and grows with Bearing, so it is not an enum; a name the core
 does not know is rejected.

scope.description: What it may reach: hosts for http, empty for the rest.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.CapabilityGrant..title: Capability Grant
